A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same WyckoffDiff research work. All 18 pages, including equations, figures, tables and appendices A–G, support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v3 reports original WBM and Carbon24 generation experiments, prototype and energy analyses, and DFT calculations for generated materials.

after.justification: v4 reports original WBM and Carbon24 generation experiments, prototype and energy analyses, and DFT calculations for generated materials.

M1.justification: The protostructure representation, discrete diffusion procedure, WyckoffGNN architecture, training objective and generation algorithms are unchanged. The earlier architectural variant described in Appendix G.3 is present in both versions.

E1.justification: Both versions use WBM and Carbon24 for the same generation tasks and retain the same materials-discovery demonstration against the WBM and Materials Project convex hull.

E2.justification: CDVAE, DiffCSP++ and SymmCD remain the evaluated baselines in the corresponding WBM, Carbon24 and compositional-validity comparisons. No comparator is added or removed.

E3.justification: Data splits, metrics, training budgets, sample counts and invalid-sample filtering are unchanged. The materials-selection, relaxation and DFT procedures also match in Section 5 and Appendix G.

E4.justification: The prior-distribution and training-duration comparisons, prototype-novelty analysis, formation-energy histograms, validity analysis and selected-material case studies are retained without substantive revision.

E5.justification: Table 1 specifies the same three models trained with different seeds and the same reporting of averages and standard deviations. Uncertainty reporting elsewhere is also unchanged.

E6.justification: Results match throughout Tables 1, 2 and 4–6, Appendix D and Figures 2–4. For example, Table 1 retains WyckoffDiff-zeros FWD values of 0.48 ± 0.02 overall and 4.34 ± 0.56 for novel materials.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, diffusion equations, message-passing formulation and noise schedule in Equations 1–11 are unchanged. No formal assumption, derivation or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about symmetry-based generation, the neural architecture, Fréchet Wrenformer Distance, competitive generation performance and the materials-discovery demonstration.

C2.justification: Both versions retain the same interpretations of novelty and memorization, Carbon24's limited novelty, scalability constraints, geometric-realization requirements and fluoride-selection bias.

D1.justification: Table 3 and appendices A, B and G retain the same hyperparameters, approximately 38-hour A100 training time, baseline settings and DFT details. Code and data access information is unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are unchanged, including the distinctions from CDVAE, DiffCSP++, SymmCD and WyCryst in Section 2.3.

P1.justification: v4 replaces cross-reference wording such as 'Appendix A' with 'Section A' and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. The substantive prose and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: There are small spacing and line-wrapping changes, including the Bartel reference's page break across pages 9–10. Figures 1–4 and Tables 1–6 retain their content, structure and placement.

improvement.justification: v4 preserves the scientific content, empirical evidence, limitations and reproducibility information of v3, including all appendices. The cross-reference wording and minor typesetting changes establish no meaningful net improvement or deterioration in overall paper quality.
